allocation.rationale: The active prefreeze experiment (EXP-RUNTIME-38054047834) is the exact repair of blocker B2, which is readiness condition (2) for the entire flagship chain. Three consecutive packets on the deterministic credential-free REST substrate class produced zero dynamic range (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064; EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598 certificate false at freeze; EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 certificate false at design, treatment ties cold on deterministic counters at novelty >= 0.25 and loses at 0.0).
